description:
REL-TIME SOVEREIGN EXCLUSIVE ($399/mo · 5 Armed Watches): 24/7 File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Sub-2ms Tamper Tripwire & Dead Man's Switch (`reltime_watch`).
- `action: 'arm'`: Establishes a 100% Baseline Seal (automatically anchoring any unanchored files in `target_path` recursively), spawns a persistent 24/7 background Watch daemon (`<2ms` detection), and registers the Watch on the Sovereign Command Center (`/dashboard`). Supports `mode: 'auto_seal'` (auto-anchors new files added to a folder, alerts on any modified or deleted sealed file) and `mode: 'vault_lock'` (alerts on any modified, deleted, or unexpected new file).
- `action: 'status'`: Lists all armed Watches, their live Dead Man's Switch heartbeat status (`armed`, `tamper_detected`, `node_dark`), and any active breach incidents.
- `action: 'resolve'`: Acknowledges a legitimate edit ('Stand down, that was me'), re-seals the modified files into the Bitcoin Timechain, and clears the tamper alert.
- `action: 'disarm'`: Stops the 24/7 background Watch daemon for `target_path` or `watch_id`.

biometric.description: If true (default when a Passkey is linked), binds baseline and auto-sealed anchors to your Hardware Passkey (`~/.reltime/passkey.json`).

mode.description: 'auto_seal' (default: auto-anchors newly added log files while alerting if any existing sealed file is modified or deleted) or 'vault_lock' (strict lock: alerts on any modified, deleted, or newly added file).

target_path.description: Local directory or file path to guard 24/7 (required for 'arm'; optional for 'resolve'/'disarm' if `watch_id` is omitted).

name: reltime_watch
